messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated-pool-42 throughput drop + fallback flood (sev-2). Alerting policy: router_fallback_rate > 70% for 5m. Triggered at 1924123456

karen: picking this up — I'm oncall. seeing errors in router logs, requests stalled on variant v2-small and then dropped. starting timeline now.

santiago: saw a spike in 'preferred_variant_unavailable' -> router started fallback to region-us-west-2 and then to v2-small repeatedly. looks like autoscaler sent low-capacity signal to pool 42.

maria: customers reporting 503s and long tails. ticket queue rising. PD pages from 3 customers.

karen: immediate mitigation attempt 1: disable fallback policy for prod-router via console (quick toggle). doing now.

devops-bot: roll command queued: `routerctl set-fallback --policy prod-router --enable false`

karen: executed. confirm: fallback policy disabled. routing should stay on primary variant or fail closed.

alex: routing still dropping — logs show router believes pool has 0 available slots. autoscaler emitted `desired_instances=0` for dedicated-pool-42 at 1924123410 (before alert).

santiago: digging into metrics — prometheus shows `pool_available_slots` went to 0 because the metric scrape missed GPU exporter for 3 intervals. exporter had OOM kill on the host.

maria: are we sure it was exporter OOM and not the scaler mis-evaluating? customers show requests were routed and then blackholed (no error returned).

karen: runbook step — force-scale pool to safe capacity and drain router caches. doing `dedicatedctl scale --pool=42 --replicas=4 --force`

devops-bot: command accepted. scaling to 4 replicas initiated.

santiago: while replicas starting, router still attempting fallbacks to incompatible variant `v2-small-quant` for some tenants — mismatch in variant compatibility matrix caused misroute; that variant can't serve certain seq-len due to compilation mismatch.

karen: temporary traffic mitigation: apply per-customer routing override to pin to `v2-large` for affected tenants. `routerctl route-override --tenant=acme --variant=v2-large`

alex: overrides applied for top five affected tenants. I see successful requests start flowing for those. total error rate dropping from 62% -> 28%.

santiago: autoscaler logs show metric provider (node-exporter) restarted and then returned normal values; however router didn't reconcile immediately because it caches capacity signals for 60s and there was a fallback loop aggressor flag. clearing router cache now: `routerctl flush-cache --pool=42`

devops-bot: cache flush requested.

maria: customer impact note: five tenants experienced degraded responses for ~18m. two tenants had request loss for ~10m. I'll open customer-impact thread and start drafting notification.

karen: handoff — I'll stay until baseline error rate < 2% and pool stable. if anyone else needs to take next steps, ping.

santiago: root cause hypothesis: exporter OOM caused transient zero-signal to autoscaler -> autoscaler interpreted as zero load -> scaled down pool -> router fallback policy aggressively routed to fallback variants including an incompatible quantized variant -> fallback oscillation + cache timing caused blackholing behavior. Also a config drift: policy allowed variant families that didn't satisfy model constraints.

alex: follow-ups I'm going to do: 1) add guard in autoscaler to ignore missing exporter for single host for N intervals, 2) add validation in router to reject fallback variants that fail variant-compat matrix, 3) reduce router cache TTL during scaling events.

karen: logged incident in tracker: INC-192412 (drafted initial notes). attaching logs.

maria: created customer comms draft and slack DM list for affected accounts. will wait for postmortem details from eng.

devops-bot: scaling finished: 4 replicas healthy.

karen: handoff to ops rotation at 1924123799 — error rate at 1.8%, all alerts suppressed. ops-rotation please take to follow-up and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

santiago: quick data capture commands I ran (pasting snippets):

```
# recent router decisions for pool 42
curl -s http://router-metrics/api/decisions?pool=42 | jq '.|{ts:.ts,decision:.decision,variant:.variant}' | tail -n 50
```

```
# autoscaler events
kubectl -n infra logs autoscaler-1 | grep "pool-42" | tail -n 40
```

karen: postmortem owners: santiago (tech lead), alex (autoscaler), maria (customer comms). I'll assign and we should aim for a 72h follow-up.

maria: noted. I'll coordinate the timeline and incidents doc.

alex: quick note — adding temporary guard in prod to reject fallback to `v2-small-quant` until variant-compat matrix fix lands.

karen: closing live thread. will re-open if anything regresses. great coordination team. :bow:
